llm_output.markdown_excerpt: - [Documentation](https://qdrant.tech/documentation/) - [Manage Data](https://qdrant.tech/documentation/manage-data/) - Points # [Anchor](https://qdrant.tech/documentation/manage-data/points/\#points) Points The points are the central entity that Qdrant operates with. A point is a record consisting of a [vector](https://qdrant.tech/documentation/manage-data/vectors/) and an optional [payload](https://qdrant.tech/documentation/manage-data/payload/). It looks like this: ```json // This is a simple point { "id": 129, "vector": [0.1, 0.2, 0.3, 0.4], "payload": {"color": "red"}, } ``` You can search among the points grouped in one [collection](https://qdrant.tech/documentation/manage-data/collections/) based on vector similarity. This procedure is described in more detail in the [search](https://qdrant.tech/documentation/search/search/) and [filtering](https://qdrant.tech/documentation/search/filtering/) sections. This section explains how to create and manage points. Any point modification operation is asynchronous and takes place in 2 steps.
